name: B10-0236/2024 (ECR) – Continued repression of civil society and independent media in Azerbaijan and the cases of Dr Gubad Ibadoghlu, Anar Mammadli, Kamran Mammadli, Rufat Safarov and Meydan TV
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the continued repression of civil society and independent media in Azerbaijan and the cases of Dr Gubad Ibadoghlu, Anar Mammadli, Kamran Mammadli, Rufat Safarov and Meydan TV
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and asking Azerbaijan to act. It asks Azerbaijan to release people it says are jailed for speaking out, including a sick economist, rights defenders and journalists. It also asks Azerbaijan to drop the charges, let the economist travel abroad for medical care, loosen rules on independent media, and have the European Union follow these cases.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. This is a request, not a law.
- **Who it affects:** Jailed critics, rights defenders and journalists in Azerbaijan.
- **What happens next:** The EU is asked to watch the cases; Azerbaijan is asked to act.
